unsupported_credit: empty source-span credit, actual outcome and ordinary feedback retained
checkpoint_rule: final fixed-budget checkpoint; root decides arm adoption from complete evidence
confirmation_selection_rule: The single provenance candidate advances only with positive completed-score/raw delta against coverage in BOTH development replicas, pooled gain >=25 points/raw against coverage, pooled mean played score >=coverage, and pooled completed-score/raw >=temporal. Confirmation uses all three arms, 3 fresh replicas, 256 train and 128 eval each. No hyperparameter sweep. If development does not qualify, keep release state and legacy defaults.
decision_target: Discounted mean actual gains over current and up to7 subsequent observed moves, gamma.9, available-window normalization. Target = terminal reward + min(reward,1-reward)*(return-meanreturn)/maxabsdeviation; constant gains/returns keep uniform reward; endpoint rounding bounded[0,1]. Episode target mean preserved within floating-point tolerance. No oracle future actions, RNG calls or action substitution.
exposure_control: Coverage uses the same source-span API, targets and unsupported mask as provenance, but credits all actual executed spans rather than the selected final-action derivation. Temporal retains prior executed-line attribution. All arms enable runtime provenance observation equally; unsupported gameplay and ordinary feedback remain intact.
exposure_fairness: Arms share starting state, raw attempt budgets and environment/sample seeds. Each arm generates its own programs as learning proceeds; resulting episode lengths and traces may differ. No credit multiplier for repeated line events or total episode length.
generation_inputs: Code generation sees its learned state and corpus, not the board. Board/action information changes host learning targets after actual execution.
evidence_layout: Every measured attempt has an immutable per-index JSON receipt; completed phase JSONL is an atomic aggregation. Phase manifests bind every shard hash and exact count.
primary: completed episode score per raw generation attempt; incomplete episodes, failures and replay rejections count zero
interpretation: A generated-policy run includes novelty and syntax failures; fixed controls choose legal actions on every seed.
